data.name: Metro Architect
data.detailed_description:
All those cities. Endless ways to build.

Design, expand, and optimize underground transit systems inspired by real-world metro and subway networks. Each region brings a new layout and a different way to build. Expand through dense city cores, cross rivers and coastlines, manage commuter demand, and keep your network moving as each city starts to push back.

Take on different network challenges across Berlin, Hong Kong, New York, Moscow, Paris, Tokyo, London, Shanghai, Rio de Janeiro, Singapore, Toronto, and Seoul.

Design the system.

Create stations, draw routes, connect districts, and shape your metro network as the city grows. Every line you build affects passenger flow, travel time, congestion, and the long-term efficiency of your system.

Rush hour fights back.

Passenger demand keeps rising. Stations get crowded, weak routes start to fail, and delays spread across the network. Redesign lines, add capacity, and keep the city moving before the system breaks.

Features

Build, expand, optimize, redesign, panic-fix, and somehow keep your metro moving during rush hour. It gets chaotic fast, in a good way!

  • Multiple gameplay styles: play casually and grow your dream network, optimize every line for maximum efficiency, or push your system to the limit under constant passenger pressure.

  • Design your metro your way: create stations, shape routes, manage transfers, and expand your network across evolving city layouts.

  • Build across region-inspired cities and metro systems, each with different layouts, pacing, and infrastructure challenges.

  • Dynamic passenger growth and changing network demands mean every playthrough develops differently. The perfect layout in one game might collapse completely in the next.

  • Watch your metro evolve into a living system of colorful lines, dense interchanges, and moving trains, turning every map into its own transport diagram.

  • Real-world-inspired train models, infrastructure, and station designs based on underground and commuter rail systems.

  • Trains. A lot of them. Probably still not enough during rush hour.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 630 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon RX 550
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound card
  • VR Support: N/A
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or better
  • Storage: 2000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound card
  • VR Support: N/A

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics supported
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound device
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1/M2 or equivalent integrated graphics
  • Storage: 2000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound device
